c0-frame.title: Frame the cycle
c0-frame.imperative: Set the cycle flavor (shotgun | compare | refine) in the top-level flavor field; the human picks, you may recommend. Seed the FIRST cycle from templates/EXPLORER_STARTING_QUESTIONS.template.md (the itch; for whom; what does done feel like; what already exists; what would make this pointless). Record pass when framed.
c0-frame.finding: Flavor = shotgun-on-gaps (agent recommended, human did not object). Cycle 1 = starting questions + gap-hypothesis shotgun + grounding excursions.

q1.title: The itch — what precisely is bugging you today
q1.imperative: The user framed two symptoms: physics 'just shy of separability' and evo 'a little worse than people with obvious information gaps'. Which of these is the actual itch, and what made today the day? Describe the pain, not a solution. Recommended-answer offered; record the answer as finding.
q1.finding: ITCH CONFIRMED: fundamental point = beat humans at fantasy. Current push = physics as feature engine replacing raw times as evo inputs; user is convinced of the push. Usability bar for physics feeding the hookup is LOW. Physics-for-its-own-sake is real but secondary: minimum goal = feature extraction; better predictions + storytelling valuable but later. Want: capture paths to best-possible physics (documented options), not chase them all now.

q2.title: What does 'physics stability' concretely mean
q2.imperative: The stated precondition for the #601 hookup is 'physics stability'. Pin it: a metric gate (e.g. reproducible capability vector across sessions), an architectural freeze (API stops moving), or a scientific verdict (which channels are trustworthy). Record as finding.
q2.finding: STABILITY PINNED: user believes physics is basically there already. Stability = confidence the good-enough bar is reached AND future efforts are refinements, not wholesale interface rehashes. Structural items (e.g. #496 outer loop) should be SETTLED (built or explicitly closed). Wanted: the concrete next steps that take physics to good-enough-for-evo and a little past. NOT separability, not a coverage-everything mandate per se.

q3.title: Evo-vs-humans: what is the evidence and what are the named gaps
q3.imperative: What concretely shows evo underperforming humans (league standings? pts/race delta?), and which information gaps do the humans exploit that the model lacks (or vice versa)? Ground in repo artifacts where possible (fantasy push #601 metrics). Record as finding.
q3.finding: GAP MAP (user): (1) driver/circuit affinity = HUGE missing piece; (2) weekend news = big; (3) current form = handled relatively well by recent-history modules, most reliable part of evo; (4) FP features kinda suck - they TRAIL the naive 'just use FP3' baseline; (5) strategy shape: nail quali (tracks FP3 closely), then gut-check longer-term corrections over the race distance. Humans already run exactly that strategy, so prescribing it is a dead end; user wants the 'use FP3, mostly' rule DERIVED FROM DATA NATIVELY (learned weighting), not hand-prescribed. Evidence of deficit remains league-level/impressionistic; no single artifact named.

q4.title: What does done feel like
q4.imperative: Describe the world once this is handled: what can the user do that they can't now? A hookup that lifts fantasy pts/race? A physics vector they trust enough to bet on? Record as finding.

status_detail.reason: Overcome by q1/q2: done = beat humans at fantasy via physics-fed evo; physics good-enough + a little past, interfaces settled

q5.title: Kill condition — what would make this pointless
q5.imperative: Name the fact that, if true, would mean the hookup shouldn't be built (e.g. physics carries no predictive signal beyond what evo already extracts from classifications). Record as finding; plan to test it early.
q5.finding: NO KILL SWITCH (user): even physics-only-matching-FP3-order is valuable - certainty metric informs decisions + storytelling. User does not believe physics can be worse than FP3 classification (FP3-only has misleading signals + heavy noise); if it IS worse, that means the useful seam wasn't found yet - a diagnostic, not a kill. ALSO: classification-history affinity deliberately rejected as throwaway - user drives at ROOT CAUSE (physics-native affinity); would delete a classification affinity module the moment physics lands, so don't build it.

x2e.imperative: Background research excursion (brief: excursions/x2-evo-seam-brief.md). Record scoped verdict on return.

Excursions x1/x2/x3 returned + verified. Physics closer to ready than memory claimed: #496 settled, Q+R estimate stores full 2019-2026. Load-bearing spine: #513 FP fits (fp_mass/run-purpose) -> #506 honest sigma -> #450/Wave-8 direct ModuleFieldResult injection -> Wave 7A correlation screen vs 0.80 FP-data ceiling -> fantasy pts/race. 2026 multi-state aero #499/#483 promoted to hazard.
